old_caption:
The video captures a person engaged in a yo-yo trick indoors. The individual is dressed in a black hoodie featuring a logo and text, paired with black athletic pants. They are holding a green string with one pink yo-yo attached to it. The setting appears to be a modern indoor space, possibly a shopping mall or public building, characterized by large glass windows and metal railings. The background includes an escalator and some structural elements like a curved metallic ceiling and wooden paneling.

Initially, the person holds the string taut between their hands, preparing to perform the trick. As the video progresses, they begin to manipulate the string, moving it to make the yo-yo spin and move along the string. The person's movements are fluid and coordinated, showcasing skill and control over the yo-yo. The lighting in the room is bright, enhancing visibility and highlighting the vibrant color of the yo-yo against the neutral tones of the surroundings. The overall atmosphere suggests a casual yet focused activity, likely performed for entertainment or practice purposes.

They are holding a green string with two pink juggling balls attached to it. The setting appears to be a modern indoor space, possibly a shopping mall or public building, characterized by large glass windows and metal railings. The background includes an escalator and some structural elements like a curved metallic ceiling and wooden paneling.

Initially, the person holds the string taut between their hands, preparing to juggle. As the video progresses, they begin to manipulate the string, moving it rhythmically to juggle the balls. The person's movements are fluid and coordinated, showcasing skill and control over the balls. The lighting in the room is bright, enhancing visibility and highlighting the vibrant colors of the juggling balls against the neutral tones of the surroundings. The overall atmosphere suggests a casual yet focused activity, likely performed for entertainment or practice purposes.
caption:
The video captures a young man wearing glasses and a black hooded sweatshirt, standing indoors beneath a curved brushed-metal ceiling. A row of vertical pillars and glass panels forms the background, with an escalator faintly visible. He wears a teal band on his right wrist and a dark watch on his left wrist. In front of his torso, he holds a kendama toy, consisting of a glossy purple-pink ball attached by a yellow-green string to a handle. Throughout the excerpt, he continuously repositions his hands and forearms, crossing the string so the ball travels relative to his hands.

The purple ball shifts position, starting high near his raised right hand before dropping toward his left. His forearms cross in front of his body, temporarily occluding the ball as it emerges at different heights. His right hand pinches the string near his upper body while the ball hangs lower, opening the string into a triangular shape. In the later frames, his right hand grips the handle while his left hand opens palm-up, the string drawn taut and swung horizontally. The sequence ends with the ball at the lower-left and the string crossed between his hands.

infer a physical error from their mismatch, or manufacture continuity across a visible edit.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.

replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.

Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
